origine_fr: 月, la chair, et 殳, qui donnait autrefois le son mais se lit aujourd'hui shū. Au départ, 股 est la cuisse. Le mot compte aussi les brins, les courants, les odeurs, et nomme la part d'une société, 股票.
origine_en: 月, flesh, plus 殳, which once gave the sound but is now read shū. At first, 股 was the thigh. The word also counts strands, currents and smells, and names a share in a company, 股票.

phrase.pinyin: Tā mǎi le hěn duō gǔpiào.
phrase.en: He bought a lot of shares.
